entry.title: New: Resolution 497 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO D.A.R.E. HAWAI‘I TO ASSIST WITH EXPENSES RELATED TO ITS 2024 D.A.R.E. DAY CELEBRATION EVENT IN WEST HAWAI‘I

Transfers $4,990 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 8)

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 497-24, Draft 2 - 05/01/24
